runtimeImplementationStage: M18.6 after consent/threat model and M16.5 Design Freeze

crossCoreRules.collaboration: Membership, invitations, roles and group votes remain Collaboration truth
crossCoreRules.identity: Only minimal public identity and explicit consent projection; no private profile or Travel DNA copy
crossCoreRules.intelligence: Computes privacy-safe compatibility/ranking with provenance and uncertainty; owns the private behavioral model
crossCoreRules.tripJourney: Fork creates/adapts through owner commands; Social stores provenance only
crossCoreRules.memoryMedia: Echoes and experiences reference consented public IDs/projections; source content remains owner truth
crossCoreRules.places: Drops and experiences reference Place IDs; no Places lifecycle or provider copy
crossCoreRules.reviews: Authored reviews, moderation and reputation remain Reviews-owned
crossCoreRules.attention: Notification intent and delivery remain Attention-owned

forbidden: public follower or like counters as ranking authority
endless engagement feed as primary product loop
reinterpret trip_members or presence as Social relationships
copy private Identity preferences, Travel DNA, Memories or booking/provider payloads
direct Booking provider/table access or foreign Domain mutation
precise live-presence exposure without explicit purpose-bound consent
hidden global popularity or reputation score
internal: consent-scoped Experience Graph edges and lifecycle
privacy, retention, deletion propagation and moderation state
